description: \mac charset keyword with Mac OS Roman \'hh bytes
notes: \mac selects code page 10000 without an \ansicpg to say so, which is why header() reports Codepage::Unsupported(10000): the number is what the file gives. 0x8E is e-acute, 0xD1 an em dash and 0xDB the euro sign - 0xDB was CURRENCY SIGN before Mac OS 8.5. Read as Windows-1252 the em dash becomes an N-tilde.
